tmp:1381: yasir mimenu orlat lev — the removal of the 'foreskin of the heart' (spiritual blockage), effected by wisdom-speech awakening the heart
tmp:1382: yasir me'alav kol ha-pechadim — the removal of all fears from oneself, achieved by self-judgment (mishpat) of one's affairs
tmp:1384: dibburei emet — words/utterances of truth issuing from the tzaddik's thanksgiving, identified with Yaakov and the sefirah Tiferet
tmp:1385: temimei darekh — 'the wholesome of way' (Ps. 119:1), epithet for those who gaze upon the inner intellect, linked to Yaakov ish tam
tmp:1387: attaining an ever-greater comprehension (hasagah yeteirah) of Divinity — each new level of perception in the World to Come
tmp:1388: doing teshuvah upon one's previous comprehension — repenting of the earlier, now-inadequate perception of God after attaining a higher one
tmp:1391: Yitzchak and Yishmael, Yaakov and Esav — the four descendants of Avraham corresponding to the Haggadah's Four Sons and the four kingdoms in holiness
tmp:1392: middat ha-din — the divine attribute of strict judgment, here identified as the root/aspect of the yetzer hara
tmp:1393: gala — the 'wave' in Rabbah bar bar Chanah's ship tale (Bava Batra 73a), symbol of the yetzer hara that seeks to sink Israel's worth
tmp:1396: yerei Elokim — 'God-fearer,' the fear-of-God quality defining Malkhut of holiness (as opposed to Malkhut of the Sitra Achra)
tmp:1398: damim u-gevurot — the blood and severities (gevurot) released in childbirth, embodying the aspect of yirah (fear)
tmp:1399: oznayim — the ears as the organ upon which yirah (fear of God) depends ('fear hangs on the ears,' Tikkun 70), enabling perfected holy speech
tmp:1400: ba-keseh — 'at the covered/appointed time' (Ps. 81:4), expounded as kisse/concealment: hidden fear-of-God given over to the heart, root of glory
tmp:1401: contemplation by the intellect of God's greatness and exaltedness — the higher fear (yirat ha-romemut) arising from knowing He is great and sovereign
tmp:1402: the 'first' (higher) fear — yirah stemming directly from God's greatness and exaltedness, above fear reached via lower frights
tmp:1403: tzaddikei ha-dor — the righteous leaders of the generation, sole conduits through whom fear and love of God are received
tmp:1407: fear ascending out of the kelipah and the nations — yirah fallen into lowly frights (beasts, officials) being raised back to holy fear via self-judgment
tmp:1408: shiflut — lowliness, making oneself like dust (afar), whose 'drawing power' attracts Godliness; why God desired Israel's self-diminishment
tmp:1409: pogmin b'Malkhut — blemishing the sefirah of Malkhut, the sin that empowers Peor/Sitra Achra to 'open its mouth'
tmp:1410: Peor's power to open its mouth with evil letter-combinations (tzerufim ra'im) — the Sitra Achra's corrupt speech enabled by blemished Malkhut
tmp:1411: peace below (shalom l'matah) — the state following revelation of the Covenant of Peace after breaking the orlah, which arouses peace above
tmp:1412: yeshut v'taharah — 'existence and purity,' the post-Creation state symbolized by pure marble (shayish tahor) in the Pardes account
tmp:1413: completing and erecting the structure of prayer — the tzaddikim of each generation raising seemingly unanswered prayers and building the full stature (like Moshe erecting the Mishkan)
tmp:1414: avodat ha-Torah — the service of Torah study, ranked above commerce; the 'Yissachar in your tents' vocation
tmp:1415: 'Yissachar b'ohalekha' — the blessing-phrase (cf. Deut. 33:18) denoting Yissachar the tent-dwelling Torah scholar, counterpart to Zevulun's commerce
tmp:1417: God's yearning from above to dwell with you — the Holy One's desire, drawn solely to truth, to make His dwelling with the truthful person (the ark's 'amah from above')
tmp:1418: the nullification of the kelipot (husks of impurity) — their annihilation through joy, as in Israel's future joyous exodus from exile
tmp:1419: subduing one's animality (behemiyut) — 'plowing' the beast-nature ('your field for your cattle'), which reveals the totality of the supernal colors
tmp:1421: removal of the clouds covering the eye — dispelling the anannin (alien thoughts in prayer) that blind the eye of judgment, restoring Ein Mishpat
tmp:1422: yit'aved ra'am — the 'thunder is made' (Zoharic idiom): the purifying thunder produced by the quarrels among true tzaddikim that expels the Other Side
tmp:1426: Eretz Kena'an — the Land of Canaan expounded as 'ka'an ani' (here is a pauper), the state of poverty caused by machloket (strife)
tmp:1428: Kena'an — the name Canaan itself as wordplay 'ka'an ani' (here is a poor man), signifying poverty from dispute (per Pesachim 50a)
tmp:1429: Edom — the nation/kingdom of Esau ('who comes from Edom'), identified with the liver (kaved), seat of anger and blood
tmp:1430: kaved — the liver, bodily organ of blood and anger corresponding to Edom/Esau, subdued through fasting or Shabbat eating
tmp:1431: shultanei rugzin — the Zoharic 'rulers of wrath' (Terumah 135b), wrathful powers embodying the angry liver that flee on Shabbat
tmp:1432: kaved ko'es — 'the liver is angry' (physiological dictum): the liver as seat of anger, whose power is nullified by holy Shabbat eating
tmp:1434: kevod El — 'the glory of God' (Ps. 19:2) as an epithet for prayer ('render glory His praise'), the vessel into which Torah-letters/souls are enclothed
tmp:1436: zevichat ha-yetzer hara — the 'slaughtering' of the evil inclination, accomplished by silence (dom) under insult, God felling its 'corpses'
tmp:1437: kavod Eloki — Divine honor/glory (as opposed to one's own honor), attained by staying silent under disgrace and not defending personal honor
tmp:1438: shemirat ha-brit in its two aspects — guarding the covenant (sexual purity) in both its higher and lower modes, the means of sustaining 'the glory of God forever'
